We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Defendant 曾某芬, with accomplice 阿某, stole a motorcycle. They used screwdriver to break lock, stole motorcycle, sold for 2000 yuan, got 800 yuan. They were caught later. This is theft (盗窃). No mention of concealment or disguise of stolen property? They stole a motorcycle and sold it. The earlier correction lesson about "盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" applies when there is concealment, e.g., they spray-painted the stolen motorcycle to hide it. Here they just stole and sold. No mention of covering up. So only 盗窃.

Check other possible crimes: maybe "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. "非法持有毒品"? No. "诈骗"? No. So just 盗窃.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
